name: Base Dollar
oneLiner: BD is a pre-launch Liquity V2 fork on Base, designed as an overcollateralized dollar stablecoin minted against LP token collateral and earning AERO yield.
collateral: LP-collateralized stablecoin forking Liquity V2 on Base L2; yield generated from AERO farming, with revenue split between users, protocol-owned liquidity treasury, and BD stakers
pegMechanism: Liquity V2-style Base fork: BD is minted against LP token collateral and each BaseD stablecoin is designed to be redeemable for $1 of system collateral, with collateral redemption and borrower/liquidation incentives supporting the dollar peg

launchPhaseDetail: Fork of Liquity V2 on Base; external security audit completed; high and medium severity fixes merged. Post-audit remediation continued through mid-May 2026 (oracle staleness-check, TWAP/slippage, and sAMM-overflow fixes merged via GitHub); GitHub shows an expanded multi-collateral scope (ETH, wstETH, rETH, cbETH, cbBTC, AERO, and LP tokens) with launch parameters updated for safety. The prior Q2 2026 target window ended on June 30, 2026 without a public mainnet deployment or sourced replacement launch window.
